title: From the Paleolithic to the Armenian genocide
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
Category: Reference, Information and Interdisciplinary subjects
summary: The second volume of the «Eurasiatica» series brings together a number of essays that reflect the different lines of enquiry through which both Italian and foreign scholars devote themselves to the Caucasus and Central Asia. The texts in this volume bring together archaeological, philological, historical, linguistic, and theological material, making a significant contribution to the expansion of research in these areas.
